lines: Sab kahan, kuchh laala-o-gul mein numaayan ho gayin
Khaak mein kya sooratein hongi ke pinhaan ho gayin
couplets.en: Only a few faces have come to light in tulip and rose, and who can imagine the faces that lie hidden in the dust?

lines: Ranj se khoogar hua insaan to mit jaata hai ranj
Mushkilein mujh par padi itni ke aasaan ho gayin
couplets.en: Sorrow fades as we grow used to it, and so many troubles fell to me that they became easy to bear.

lines: Yun hi gar rota raha Ghalib
Dekhna in bastiyon ko tum ke veeraan ho gayin
couplets.en: If Ghalib goes on weeping like this, you will see these towns laid desolate.
